title: India-UK Trade Deal Kicks Off: What It Means for Your Wallet
description: India and the UK are launching a new trade agreement from July 15, 2026. This deal will cut or remove import taxes (tariffs) on many goods traded between the .

faq.q: What is a Free Trade Agreement (FTA)?
faq.a: A Free Trade Agreement (FTA) is a pact between two or more countries to reduce or eliminate import duties (tariffs) and other trade barriers on goods and services exchanged between them, making trade cheaper and easier.

faq.q: Which Indian products are expected to benefit most from this deal?
faq.a: Indian exports in labour-intensive sectors such as textiles, leather, footwear, marine products, sports goods, toys, gems and jewellery, engineering goods, auto components, and organic chemicals are expected to see significant benefits.

faq.q: Which UK products might become cheaper in India?
faq.a: British goods like whisky, gin, and cosmetics are among those for which India will reduce or eliminate tariffs, potentially making them more affordable for consumers in India.

faq.q: When does this trade agreement officially start?
faq.a: The India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) is scheduled to come into force on July 15, 2026.

faq.q: Will this agreement affect jobs in India?
faq.a: Yes, the agreement is expected to create new opportunities and potentially generate employment, especially in India's export-oriented and labour-intensive sectors, due to increased demand and easier market access to the UK.
